name: nimiq.bitmesh
exemptReason: Native true-BLE-mesh app (iOS Swift + Android Kotlin sharing a Rust core via UniFFI). A web PWA cannot act as a BLE peripheral, so the fleet vanilla-PWA + Bun/Hono web stack does not apply. Approved divergence — see docs/adr/0001.

styling.notes: Brand identity reserved for Andjroo (Nimiq-brand vs distinct mesh identity). nimiq-ui is web-only; native UI will mirror Nimiq tokens manually. See needs:owner.

settlement.notes: Signs Nimiq tx fully offline (Ed25519 over serializeContent, ~139B), relays the self-contained signed bytes over a Bitchat-derived BLE mesh, and a gateway node calls sendRawTransaction (plain JSON-RPC) at the first internet hop. Mirrors the fleet sign-offline/broadcast-online seam (sendhome + nimiq.sale). NEVER instantiates the @nimiq/core consensus client. Defaults to TESTNET (networkId=5); mainnet is gated behind Andjroo.

deploy.notes: Distribution (TestFlight / Play internal) + provisioning reserved for Andjroo. No deploy by the loop. On-device BLE mesh interop verified on Andjroo's Mac + real phones.

config.lint: cargo clippy + cargo fmt (+ swiftlint/ktlint where available)
config.ci: github-actions (core on ubuntu, ios on macos runner, android on ubuntu)

autonomy.moneyPathDefinition: any goal that signs, handles keys/seed, or broadcasts a transaction
